key_insight: An LLM agent recovered usable Urbach-energy estimates from failed spectral analyses while leaving numerical extraction to deterministic code.
engineering_relevance: Autonomous exception handling can reduce manual analysis bottlenecks in self-driving laboratories without forcing unreliable property estimates.
method: Run a predefined deterministic spectral-analysis script.
Assess spectra and fitting diagnostics; retain valid results unchanged.
Retry failures with bounded fitting-parameter adjustments, returning NaN when evidence is insufficient.
evidence_signal: Across 203 β-Ga2O3 film spectra, the agent retained 183 baseline estimates, recovered 16 of 20 failures, and returned NaN for 4.
watch_item: Evaluation covered one material and measurement workflow; reliability across other spectra and fitting models remains unestablished.
paper_title: Autonomous adaptive spectral analysis with an LLM agent for self-driving laboratories
